name: agency-agents
description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
one_liner: A set of pre-built AI 'employees' with specific personas — a frontend specialist, a Reddit community manager, a reality-checker — that you assign tasks to like a tiny virtual agency.
buyer: A solo marketer or small agency owner who can't afford a full team of specialists but needs specialist-level output across several disciplines.
business_use_cases: A solo marketer runs client content (social copy, community replies, landing pages) through the relevant persona agents instead of hiring freelancers per task.
A small agency uses it to pitch more clients than its human headcount would normally allow, using the agents as a first-pass production layer.
A startup founder without a marketing team uses the 'community ninja' and 'whimsy injector' personas to keep up a consistent social presence solo.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'virtual marketing team' retainer to small businesses who can't afford a real one.
Sell one-off 'content sprint' packages (a month of social posts, landing page copy) produced through the agent set.

steal_this: Pick one local business this weekend, run a month of their social content through the relevant persona agents, and sell it as a flat-fee 'content sprint' package.
